configuration.scope: Conditional examples at 1 K intrinsic polarization RMS at 30 MHz, with assumed local columns and angular statistics. Linear and PCHIP native-beam interpolants define a model comparison, not a measured fine-channel response. Gaussian visibility illustrations retain the complex relation and both sidereal phases. No detection significance is inferred.

scope: All profiles and local screens, shared physical-frequency fit, actual folded channels and finite sidereal averaging. The non-Gaussian global variance mixture has the same RM covariance as its Gaussian reference; its additional mean variation is retained in the speckle. Numerical errors are exported beside the residuals; tiny components can only support upper bounds.
